ValidationRule.description: When the Payment_Terms__c is checked, user must provide complementary information
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& Payment_Terms__c = true
&& ( ISBLANK(Payment_Terms_Comments__c)
|| ISPICKVAL( Old_Payment_Terms__c, "" )
|| ISPICKVAL( New_Payment_Terms__c , "")
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : New Payment Terms, Old Payment Terms, Payment Terms Comments
